target:
Create the production visual target for English Game Broken Graveyard. Reference image 1 is the graveyard P north star; reference 2 is the exact accepted native-96-pixel protagonist and reference 3 the accepted tombstone. Match their mature finely drawn true pixel RPG aesthetic, dark restrained outlines, low saturation stone and cloth, top-left lighting. New composition, 960x540 landscape native pixel scene, 3/4 overhead game view without horizon or perspective vanishing point. One output pixel is one art pixel, no antialiasing, no smooth gradients, no painterly rendering, no bloom, no labels or text, no UI. It must feel like a playable dark fantasy RPG room, not an illustration.
Composition: a narrow entrance at bottom-left between two worn tombstones, an intermittent old small stone path leads diagonally inward through a derelict burial area along the left and upper edges, opens into a wide quiet muddy clearing in center/right beside a collapsed open grave on the right, then a narrow path leaves at upper-right. The small open grave is a dark empty recess lined by broken stone lips, not a giant crater. Sparse large gnarled leafless tree on upper-left rim, upright and leaning mossy tombstones around perimeter, no more than 7 props. Include ONE exact same worn survivor protagonist as reference at the lower-middle path, visibly 96 pixels tall in the native 540-high scene, as a scale witness. No monsters, no sigils this time.
Ground is dark cool gray-brown wet mud, large quiet areas, restrained small cold slate-blue puddles, sparse tufts of dead grass and olive moss. Broken flat stepping stones occupy only a little of the ground. NOT a paved floor. Character clearly lighter and warmer than ground. No cast ground shadows under props, no fog baked over the assets. Palette restricted to muted warm charcoal browns and stone neutrals plus cool blue-gray puddles and olive moss, under 64 colors. Keep generous clear navigable center. Render wide 16:9 pixel scene, intended final exact 960x540. Match the visible P image above, preserving pixel cluster craft and restrained texture.
